OIL INDIA LIMITED - DULIAJAN
DAILY DRILLING REPORT
WELL: DUL-011          FIELD: Duliajan          RIG: OIL-RIG-14
REPORT DATE: 14-Mar-2019          REPORT NO: 045

14-Mar-2019: 0600-1200 hrs: Drilling 12-1/4" hole ahead 2510m to 2548m in
TIPAM SST, MW 1.30 sg, ROP avg 6.5 m/hr, gas background normal.

1230 hrs: Total mud losses observed while drilling at 2545m in Tipam sst,
pit level dropped 12 bbl in 30 min with no gain, partial returns only.
Suspected loss into a natural fracture zone in the sandstone.

1300 hrs: Stopped drilling, reduced MW to 1.27 sg, pumped 40 bbl LCM
(medium/coarse) pill at reduced rate. Returns improved after pill, regained
full returns by 1500 hrs. Resumed drilling with monitored losses <2 bbl/hr.

1500-2400 hrs: Drilling ahead to 2565m, no further losses, mud checks
normal. NPT this 24 hrs: 2 hrs (mud loss and remedial pumping).
